description: The transcripts of MAGICDATA Mandarin Chinese Conversational Speech Corpus. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are MagicData-RAMC's per-recording text files, inside archives that total about 15 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
